title.narrative: Nachhaltige sozio-ökonomische Entwicklung der indigenen Bevölkerung in Bangladesch
Sustainable socio-economic development of the indigenous population in Bangladesh

description.narrative: Der Lebensstandard der indigenen Gemeinschaft hat sich durch nachhaltige ökologische Landwirtschaft und Selbstständigkeit verbessert. The living standards of the indigenous community have improved through sustainable organic agriculture and self-reliance. The families in the target group grow rice with seeds they have bred themselves, have converted to organic farming, are getting better prices for their products and are working to protect the climate and preserve biodiversity.
